The memo accurately represents all key financial terms found in the source document:

- Correctly identifies the date (May 13, 2022)
- Accurately names all parties (Texas-New Mexico Power Company as Borrower, KeyBank National Association as Administrative Agent, CoBank, ACB as new Lender)
- Correctly states the commitment amount ($25,000,000)
- Properly references the Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 11, 2022
- Accurately describes the Sixteenth Supplemental Indenture and Replacement First Mortgage Bonds
- Correctly notes compliance with Section 2.1(f) requirements
- Appropriately marks unavailable terms (interest rate, maturity date, payment frequency, deal price) as "N/A"

All substantive financial and transaction terms in the memo are directly supported by information in the source document. The memo does not fabricate or hallucinate any key financial terms.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo comprehensively captures all key financial terms available in the source document:

- Deal size ($25,000,000 commitment from CoBank, ACB)
- Transaction date (May 13, 2022)
- Borrower name (Texas-New Mexico Power Company)
- Administrative Agent (KeyBank National Association)
- New Lender (CoBank, ACB)
- Collateral details (First Mortgage Bonds under Sixteenth Supplemental Indenture)
- Covenant compliance representation

The source document is an Increase Supplement that focuses on adding a new lender rather than establishing comprehensive facility terms. The memo appropriately marks unavailable information (interest rates, maturity date, payment frequency) as "N/A" since these terms are not specified in this particular supplement document but would be found in the underlying Credit Agreement.
